data.title: Entry-Level Manual QA Tester
data.fitReason: The candidate's 6-month internship as a manual tester is a direct match for this role. They already have exposure to bug reporting, test case execution, and SDLC processes in a professional environment, which is precisely what entry-level QA positions require. This is the strongest alignment with their existing verified experience.

data.title: Junior Frontend Developer
data.fitReason: The candidate has hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript through two personal projects, which covers the core technical baseline for junior frontend roles. However, the absence of any JavaScript framework such as React or Vue, combined with a thin and unvalidated portfolio, limits competitiveness against peers who have framework exposure.

data.title: QA Intern
data.fitReason: This is the highest-confidence fit. The candidate has already completed this exact role and can re-enter at a stronger standing with documented experience. Suitable if transitioning to a new company or domain while building toward a full-time QA position. Companies hiring QA interns typically require manual testing basics, which this candidate fully satisfies.

data.title: Web Content Editor (Technical)
data.fitReason: HTML and CSS skills are directly applicable to roles managing and formatting web content within CMS platforms or static sites. The candidate can make structural and styling changes without developer support. This is a lower-competition entry point that leverages existing front-end fundamentals while the candidate builds deeper development skills.

data.title: Software QA Analyst Trainee
data.fitReason: Trainee QA analyst roles are designed for candidates with foundational QA exposure and no automation skills, which aligns precisely with this candidate's profile. The internship provides credibility, and the IT diploma satisfies academic requirements. Many outsourcing firms in Da Nang actively hire at this level for project-based testing work.

data.title: HTML Email Developer
data.fitReason: HTML email development is a niche but accessible entry-level role that relies heavily on HTML and CSS table-based layout skills. The candidate's front-end fundamentals are sufficient to begin in this area with minimal upskilling. It is less competitive than general frontend roles and offers a clear entry point into digital marketing or product teams.

data.title: Junior UI Tester
data.fitReason: The candidate's dual exposure to both front-end development and manual QA makes them particularly well-suited for UI testing roles, where understanding of HTML structure and CSS layout helps identify rendering issues, layout bugs, and cross-browser inconsistencies. This combination is a genuine differentiator over pure QA candidates with no front-end knowledge.

data.title: Technical Support Associate
data.fitReason: An IT diploma combined with manual testing exposure provides enough technical grounding to handle tier-1 and tier-2 technical support for software products. The candidate understands bug documentation and software behavior, which translates well to diagnosing user-reported issues. This role is widely available in Da Nang's outsourcing sector.

data.title: Entry-Level Web Developer Intern
data.fitReason: Although the candidate has already completed one internship, web developer internships at agencies or startups frequently accept candidates with basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills alongside personal project portfolios. This could serve as a strategic step to gain framework exposure and mentorship if the candidate's front-end portfolio is strengthened beforehand.

data.title: Test Documentation Coordinator
data.fitReason: Some QA teams in larger IT outsourcing firms in Vietnam require coordinators to write, organise, and maintain test cases, bug reports, and testing documentation. The candidate's internship experience with test case execution and bug reporting satisfies the core requirement. This is a lower-technical-intensity entry point within the QA track that remains relevant to career progression.
